purpose: Disclose implementation details and protocol wording differences; does not change strategy or reported results.
rank_feature: Actual X uses 1-2q. Initial protocol said 2q-1. With the zero symmetric independent prior on this coefficient, changing both training and prediction sign is an equivalent reparameterization; all formulas in the final report use actual code.
common_start: Clarified before viewing new performance: first date with at least126 mature label-origin dates for every candidate, actually2009-08-07. All fixed and selective accounts use this common start and continue through evaluation boundaries. ROLL starts2017-01-02.
rolling_no_entry: No-entry state blocks new tickers; existing holdings may still increase or decrease under last active Bayesian model. Initial protocol phrase prevent increases was broader than the implemented and pre-result clarified existing-position management.
probability_calibration: Main probability diagnostics assess realized predictive probabilities of the development-selected H20/W1008 model on all completed, eligible top10%-nearness stock/date cases. They are not independent Bernoulli trials or only filled transactions.
closed_holding_duration: FIFO matched sold quantities are weighted by sale notional, not by share count. Open residual holdings are excluded.
fixed_comparison: Old fixed-horizon ledger is preserved including same-day ticker order netting and8% new-allocation capacity. Fixed entry uses floor10% of quarantined eligible count; selective entry uses rank percentile among data-qualified names before quarantine. Thus FIXED5 versus BUFFER is a practical policy comparison, not a perfect one-parameter retention ablation. BUFFER versus BUFFER_BAND and BAYES versus BAYES_NOBAND are matched band comparisons.
solver: Certificate pertains to pre-band convex optimum. Final band and0.5bp utility hurdle are policy heuristics checked again for objective improvement.
labels: Forward labels use marked adjusted prices and lastmark recovery convention. Terminal marks need not be executable sells when trading is suspended; live portfolio fills still require positive volume and price.
trade_timestamp: orders decision_date is latest previous-close authorization, including reauthorized pending exits. It is not necessarily the first date that an unfilled exit was requested. Review-level decisions are stored separately.
